text:
Welcome back, Maya. Last time you were weighing $200K into the SpaceX IPO — your deadline is this Sunday, June 15.

Here's where we left it on Monday: the cash route (~$235K available) costs you essentially nothing in tax but uses your liquidity cushion. Selling the Apple would run about $18,500 in tax, though it would also trim a concentrated position. The Robinhood shares are the most expensive to sell tax-wise, about $14,500 on $96K.

You also said you hate the idea of paying tax on the Apple you bought back in 2015 — so if that's still true, the cash route or a partial mix may be the paths to pressure-test.

The open questions we flagged for Dana: how a locked-up $200K position fits alongside your $9,000/month income plan, what it means for the lake house timeline, and whether spending running above plan changes the math.

With five days left, this is the week to get Dana's eyes on it. Want me to send her the summary and request a call before Friday?
suggested: What changed since I was last here?
